name: AXE AI | Sort All Conversation Sheets by Timestamp

parameters.content:
## Sort every client conversation sheet by timestamp

**Manual trigger only.** Run on demand (e.g. after a batch of Gmail/Outlook processing) rather than per-message -- sorting after every single row append would mean two extra Sheets API calls per message; sorting all sheets in one pass afterward is far cheaper and the end result is identical.

What it does:
1. Lists every client root folder under the 3 known provider-parent Drive folders (gmail-only, outlook-only, combined) -- same enumeration as the row_number cleanup workflow.
2. For each client folder, finds its "conversation" Google Sheet (skips clients that don't have one yet).
3. Looks up that sheet's actual tab name AND numeric sheetId (gid) at runtime -- both vary per sheet (random gid, inconsistent tab names), same reason the Processor workflows resolve this dynamically instead of hardcoding it.
4. Reads the header row and finds which column is literally named "timestamp" (skips sheets that don't have one -- shouldn't happen, but safe rather than guessing a position).
5. Sorts rows 2+ (header excluded) by that column, ascending -- oldest message first, matching when it was actually sent/received rather than whatever order the processor happened to log it in.

Run by clicking 'Execute workflow' on the Manual Trigger. Check the final node's output for a per-sheet summary of what was sorted vs skipped.

**Fixed:** 'Pick Exact Conversation Sheet Match' used to keep only the FIRST match across all clients (so only one sheet was ever sorted), and the later Code nodes only processed the first item. Now every client's sheet is processed; Sheets calls are paced (~1/sec) with retries to stay under Google's per-minute quota.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ requests: [ { sortRange: { range: { sheetId: $json.tabSheetId, startRowIndex: 1, startColumnIndex: 0 }, sortSpecs: [ { dimensionIndex: $json.timestampColumnIndex, sortOrder: 'ASCENDING' } ] } } ] }) }}

parameters.jsCode: return { json: { spreadsheetId: $json.spreadsheetId, tabName: $json.tabName, result: 'skipped (no timestamp column)' } };
